name: Younited Financial S.A.
summary: Younited Financial S.A. provides consumer credit services in France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and internationally. The company offers credit and point-of-sale financing; open banking services; insurance product distribution; and credit protection insurance products, including life, disability, and unemployment coverage, as well as affinity insurance products. It also provides unsecured personal loans; budget advisory services; and daily banking services, such as current accounts, payment cards, savings products and cashback solutions delivered through a digital mobile and web application. Younited Financial S.A. is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg.
